# Policy chain fixture

**Bottom line:** A law is not the same as implementation or impact. ([Example source](https://example.com/policy))

## Policy implementation chain

| Node | Actor / role | Relationship | Evidence | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Statute | Legislature | Creates a binding legal framework | [Example source](https://example.com/policy) | Impact is unknown |
| Guidance | Regulator | Operationalizes implementation | [Example source](https://example.com/guidance) | Provider compliance is not established |
| Review | Auditor | Evaluates enforcement | [Example source](https://example.com/review) | Outcome limitation |
